verdict.rationale: Inngest documents official SDKs in TypeScript, Python and Go, with SDK APIs such as createFunction(), a versioned TypeScript v4 reference including a testing library, and an official ESLint plugin. Community users report building jobs with the SDK hands-on. Missing for 10: detailed evidence of Python and Go SDK reference depth comparable to the TypeScript SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Write functions in TypeScript, Python or Go to power background and scheduled jobs, with steps built in.
you write standard TypeScript, Python, or Go functions using a simple SDK
You can create scheduled functions that run in any timezone using the SDK's createFunction()
This allows you to mock function state, step tooling, and inputs with a Jest-compatible API supporting all major testing frameworks, runtimes, and libraries
An ESLint plugin is available at @inngest/eslint-plugin, providing rules to enforce best practices when writing Inngest functions.
Writing the jobs feels very natural, much much simpler than Temporal.
